name: BTC Correlation with SPY & Gold — VIX Regime Analysis
description: Rolling 60-day Pearson correlation of BTC daily returns vs SPY and GLD. BTC/SPY correlation is split by VIX regime: high-vol (VIX >= 20) vs low-vol (VIX < 20). A separate VIX chart with a threshold reference line at 20 provides context. Summary table shows Mean, Min, Max, and Current correlation for BTC/SPY in each VIX regime and BTC/GLD overall.
source:
# BTC Correlation with SPY & Gold
# Rolling 60-day Pearson correlation of daily returns
# BTC vs SPY (equity beta) and BTC vs GLD (safe-haven relationship)

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close_btc = src.c

spy = reference_stocks(ticker='SPY')()
close_spy = spy.c

gld = reference_stocks(ticker='GLD')()
close_gld = gld.c

vix = indices(ticker='VIX')()
close_vix = vix.c

# ============================================================================
# DAILY RETURNS
# ============================================================================

ret_btc = returns(period=1)(close_btc)
ret_spy = returns(period=1)(close_spy)
ret_gld = returns(period=1)(close_gld)

# ============================================================================
# 60-DAY ROLLING CORRELATIONS (returns-based)
# ============================================================================

corr_spy_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_btc, y=ret_spy)
corr_gld_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_btc, y=ret_gld)

# ============================================================================
# VIX REGIME SPLIT — BTC/SPY correlation conditional on VIX level
# ============================================================================

corr_spy_high_vix = where(close_vix >= 20, corr_spy_60d)
corr_spy_low_vix = where(close_vix < 20, corr_spy_60d)

idx = index()

# ============================================================================
# LINE CHART — Both rolling correlations over time
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='BTC Rolling 60-Day Correlation by VIX Regime',
    category='Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Pearson Correlation (Returns-Based, 60d)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC/SPY (VIX >= 20)', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC/SPY (VIX < 20)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC / GLD', color=Color.Amber)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ])
)(idx, corr_spy_high_vix, corr_spy_low_vix, corr_gld_60d)

# ============================================================================
# VIX LEVEL CHART — synchronized time axis for context
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='VIX Level (Regime Threshold at 20)',
    category='Correlation',
    y_axis_label='VIX',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VIX Close', color=Color.Violet)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=20, title='Regime Threshold', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(idx, close_vix)

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE — Mean, Min, Max, Current for each pair
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Correlation Summary by VIX Regime',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['BTC/SPY (VIX >= 20)', 'BTC/SPY (VIX < 20)', 'BTC / GLD'],
        col_headers=['Mean', 'Min', 'Max', 'Current'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='Correlation'
)(corr_spy_high_vix, corr_spy_high_vix, corr_spy_high_vix, corr_spy_high_vix, corr_spy_low_vix, corr_spy_low_vix, corr_spy_low_vix, corr_spy_low_vix, corr_gld_60d, corr_gld_60d, corr_gld_60d, corr_gld_60d)
